baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening command to know governs the exclusive no-deity clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: The knowledge branch supplies disclosure rather than bare data, while the deity branch centers worship and the worshipped object. Their construction makes exclusive divinity something to recognize as undivided allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower gives the opening imperative the role of settled recognition and links it to the closing divine knowledge.
Worship and its object make the exclusive clause a claim on allegiance, not merely a numerical proposition.

changed_reading.before: Know the theological proposition that only God is divine.
changed_reading.after: Recognize and inhabit undivided worship of God as the governing fact of the verse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Human knowing at the opening is answered by God's knowing at the close.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated knowledge root encloses confession, forgiveness, community, movement, and residence within an asymmetry: the addressee must come to know one decisive truth, while God already knows the addressees across changing and settled states.

activation_trace.role: One disclosure branch spans both occurrences and creates the human-command versus divine-comprehension frame.
Turning a thing from face to face supplies the changing states that divine knowledge comprehends.
Staying and settling supplies the stable counterpart to change and completes the scope of divine knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The verse contains two independent statements about knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The verse is an epistemic enclosure: limited human recognition is commanded inside God's comprehensive knowledge of the recognizer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command seeks forgiveness for the addressee's own sin.
baseline_models.mechanism: Forgiveness can be pictured as a covering that preserves from an effect, while the sin root carries both culpability and a tail or trailing end. Together they allow sin to be read as culpability with an aftermath that needs protective covering.

activation_trace.role: A preserving cover provides the material action by which harmful exposure is blocked.
Covering an offense and preserving its bearer from the result fixes the material image to the actual request for forgiveness.
Culpable wrongdoing keeps the model anchored in the conventional object of the request.
A trailing end contributes the exploratory idea that wrongdoing leaves something following behind it.

changed_reading.before: Ask pardon for a discrete offense.
changed_reading.after: Ask that culpability and the harmful aftermath trailing it be covered and its bearer preserved.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular addressee must seek forgiveness for believing men and believing women as well as for self.
baseline_models.mechanism: Faith joins trusted assent to inward security; forgiveness protects that trusting community from the effects of fault. The explicit masculine and feminine collectives turn private recognition into an intercessory responsibility with broad social scope.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust give the named community an affective condition that forgiveness helps preserve.
Trusted assent identifies the two collectives as a community oriented by the known confession.
Protection from an offense's effect makes intercession a concrete form of care for that community.

changed_reading.before: The addressee performs a private penitential act and then mentions other believers.
changed_reading.after: Recognition of God immediately creates responsibility to seek protective mercy for the whole believing community, women and men alike.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: God knows the addressees' mutaqallab and mathwa.
baseline_models.mechanism: Turning from face to face and moving toward an outcome stand opposite prolonged staying and a place of lodging. The pair can function as a merism for every transition and every settled condition without forcing a choice between spatial and existential senses.

activation_trace.role: Repeated turning supplies dynamic movement and alteration within the pair.
Turning as departure and outcome lets movement include the course toward a destination.
Extended staying supplies the static pole against the changing course.
A lodging place turns the static pole into both dwelling and possible destination.

changed_reading.before: God knows where people move and where they live.
changed_reading.after: God knows the full alternation of motion and rest, reversal and outcome, temporary course and settled abode.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context gives covering opposite moral directions: hiding truth obstructs, while covering misdeeds repairs. That polarity revises the focus request into a discriminating material act: the needed cover is one that exposes allegiance to truth while shielding people from fault's consequence.

activation_trace.role: A preserving cover anchors the focus request's protective material logic.
A cover that blocks truth supplies the destructive pole against which protective forgiveness is distinguished.
Effacing an offense by covering it supplies the reparative pole and closely parallels the focus request.

structural_cues: 47:1 and 47:2 place obstructive covering and remedial covering in immediate contrast before the focus verse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed covering images and the focus supplies protective forgiveness; I infer a shared material analogy with reversed moral direction, while the live alternative is that these are merely separate conventional lexical uses.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness is a uniformly positive act of concealment.
changed_reading.after: Covering is morally directional: concealing truth destroys, but covering admitted fault protects and repairs.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following falsehood versus following stable truth, followed by the contrast between divine patronage and no patronage, turns the exclusive deity clause into a practical sorting of paths and loyalties.

activation_trace.role: Exclusive worship is the focus anchor that receives the contextual path and loyalty structure.
Following behind a lead supplies the enacted movement by which allegiance becomes visible.
Loss of truth and stability marks one followed path as unable to hold.
Stable correspondence with reality marks the alternative path as firm enough to follow.
Love, support, and alliance translate exclusive worship into the social relation of patronage.

structural_cues: 47:3 uses parallel following clauses for falsehood and truth; 47:11 uses a patron versus no-patron contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed paths and patronage, and I infer that exclusive worship governs whom one follows and relies on; a live alternative keeps the focus clause primarily doctrinal and treats those relations as consequences rather than its content.

changed_reading.before: The no-deity clause is an isolated confession.
changed_reading.after: The confession reorients following, reliance, and alliance toward the one stable object of worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel through the earth, reflective sight of prior outcomes, an explicitly named abode, and forgiveness placed within the destination contrast add a life-course and final-outcome axis to the focus pair of turning and settling.

activation_trace.role: Departure and eventual outcome let the focus movement term carry a whole course rather than a single location change.
Lodging anchors the endpoint side of the focus pair.
Going onward supplies an observable historical course through space.
Directed sight and reflection turn travel into evidence-bearing observation.
The last part and outcome connect the traversed course to its consequential end.
The same lodging branch appears in an explicitly consequential destination and charges the focus term eschatologically.
Forgiveness among the promised provisions links the focus request to the favorable side of the destination contrast.

structural_cues: 47:10 orders travel and observation of outcomes; 47:12 contrasts garden admission with a fire abode; 47:15 contrasts promised provision and forgiveness with destructive drink.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies journey, aftermath, explicit lodging, and destination-linked forgiveness; I infer a lifespan-to-endpoint mapping, while ordinary daily movement and dwelling remain a materially live reading of the focus pair.

changed_reading.before: God knows each ordinary movement and residence.
changed_reading.after: God knows the moral-historical course and the final lodging it reaches, alongside the still-live ordinary spatial reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sudden arrival and remembrance that becomes available only when arrival has occurred give temporal force to the focus command: recognition must happen before the point at which recollection no longer changes the course.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors the commanded recognition that must precede the approaching limit.
Unannounced arrival supplies the closing temporal boundary that makes knowing urgent.
A reminder at the moment of arrival supplies the contrast between timely recognition and belated recollection.

structural_cues: The focus verse follows 47:18 directly and opens with a consequence-marking connective before the knowledge imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate adjacency, surprise, and belated remembrance; I infer that the connective makes knowledge the timely response, while a live alternative reads it as a general continuation without a tight causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: Acquire a durable item of theological knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Know now, before sudden arrival converts possible recognition into ineffective hindsight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus context calls a group believers yet depicts diseased hearts and a deathlike covering of awareness. This revises the focus's communal prayer from care for an already secure class into ongoing support for a named community that can contain fear, impaired motion, and unstable hearts.

activation_trace.role: Inward security supplies the expected condition against which contextual instability registers.
Protective forgiveness gives the addressee a response to communal vulnerability rather than a label of perfection.
The same trusted-assent branch names the addressed group before their reactions expose internal differentiation.
The heart as understanding and inward disposition localizes the instability within the apparently believing group.
Impairment and restricted movement turn heart-sickness into a failure to advance when action becomes concrete.
A covering that overwhelms awareness supplies the deathlike arrest visible in their gaze.
The alternate mapped branch also covers understanding, reinforcing cognitive arrest without collapsing the split root.

structural_cues: 47:20 begins with believers requesting revelation, then narrows to those whose hearts are diseased when its demand becomes decisive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared community label and an impaired subset; I infer that this vulnerability helps explain prayer for believers, while the live alternative is that the subset is exceptional and should not characterize the wider community.

changed_reading.before: Believers form an already secure community for whom additional prayer is honorific.
changed_reading.after: The believing community remains internally vulnerable, so intercession is continuing care rather than certification of settled security.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning away leads to broken relations; reflective looking toward consequences is blocked by locked hearts; then explicit turning back follows disclosed guidance. This sequence moralizes the focus pair: mutaqallab can include reversals of allegiance, and mathwa can include the state in which those reversals settle.

activation_trace.role: Turning from one face or direction to another anchors moral reversal in the focus wording.
Settled staying supplies the contrasting state in which a repeated orientation may harden.
Turning the back in refusal supplies the contextual moral direction of movement.
Severing a bond gives social consequence to the act of turning away.
Looking into consequences supplies the reflective movement that locked hearts fail to perform.
Closure and hardness provide the static obstruction that arrests reflective turning.
Explicit reversal from commitment gives the focus movement term a live moral and confessional sense.

structural_cues: 47:22-25 forms a sequence of turning away, relational severance, locked hearts, and backward movement after guidance had become clear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of spatially expressed moral reversals and closure; I infer that it activates an inward sense of the focus motion-settlement pair, while spatial movement and final abode remain independent alternatives.

changed_reading.before: Mutaqallab and mathwa name movement and residence.
changed_reading.after: They may also name every reversal of allegiance and the inward condition in which an orientation becomes settled or locked.

context_deltas.mechanism: God's knowledge of concealed arrangements is followed by human recognition through visible marks and the slant of speech, then by God's knowledge of deeds. The focus closing can therefore encompass hidden vacillation that may leave readable traces without equating human diagnosis with divine comprehension.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive disclosure anchors the divine knowledge into which hidden and manifest states are gathered.
A distinguishing mark opens a secondary focus possibility: knowledge can operate through traces that guide recognition.
Divine knowing explicitly reaches what the speakers keep concealed.
Inward concealment supplies the hidden layer of allegiance that outward speech does not exhaust.
Recognition by an effect or sign provides the human diagnostic counterpart to divine knowledge.
A visible imprint makes an otherwise concealed condition legible on the person.
The alternate mapped root also contributes a recognizable sign, preserving the split inventory's convergent activation.
The inclination of speech toward an implied sense makes vocal form another trace of concealed orientation.
Knowledge through distinguishing traces closes the diagnostic sequence while remaining subordinate to divine knowing.

structural_cues: 47:26 ends with God knowing concealed speech; 47:30 moves from possible showing, to recognition by marks and speech, to God knowing deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies secrecy, recognition, marks, speech inflection, and divine knowledge; I infer that hidden turnings can become outward traces, while a live alternative limits the sequence to diagnosis of a particular hostile subgroup.

changed_reading.before: God knows movements and residences that remain opaque to everyone else.
changed_reading.after: God knows concealed orientations completely, while some inner turnings may also surface as marks and inflections that humans partially recognize.

context_deltas.mechanism: Testing makes the condition of strivers, patient people, and their reports appear. Read beside the focus assertion that God knows, knowledge becomes not only prior comprehension but also disclosed, evidenced knowledge enacted in history.

activation_trace.role: Prior divine comprehension creates the tension that the later testing language must reshape rather than erase.
Testing that brings a condition into appearance supplies the mechanism for manifested knowledge.
The alternate mapped root likewise joins examination to disclosure, preserving the split root's parallel evidence.
The later knowledge occurrence directly connects testing's disclosure to the focus knowledge frame.
Exertion under difficulty provides conduct in which an inward claim becomes observable.
Self-restraint under distress provides a second observable condition disclosed by trial.
Reports and inward reality become the tested evidence through which hidden condition is made known.

structural_cues: 47:19 states that God knows; 47:31 says testing continues until knowledge and tests both agents and their reports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing whose branch makes condition appear; I infer a distinction between prior divine comprehension and knowledge manifested in evidence, while a materially live alternative hears the later clause as temporal acquisition at the discourse level.

changed_reading.before: God's knowing is a static inventory of already known states.
changed_reading.after: God's knowing also has a historical mode in which hidden states are made manifest through exertion, restraint, and tested report.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later refusal of forgiveness to those who persist in truth-covering until death places a terminal boundary beside the focus's broad prayer for believing women and men. Intercession is expansive within the named community but is not presented as an automatic erasure detached from final orientation.

activation_trace.role: Protection from an offense's consequence anchors the expansive request whose limit is being tested.
Trusted assent defines the explicit community included in the focus intercession.
Persistent blocking of truth supplies the opposed final orientation.
Loss of life fixes the point at which that opposed orientation is described as terminal.
The same forgiveness branch is explicitly negated, creating a boundary around the focus request.

structural_cues: 47:34 repeats the opening obstruction pattern, adds persistence through death, and then negates forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed community labels and an explicit terminal negation; I infer a boundary on automatic outcome, while the live alternative treats 47:34 only as a statement about a distinct group and not as a direct limit on the act of prayer in 47:19.

changed_reading.before: The broad intercession sounds potentially unconditional.
changed_reading.after: The prayer is broad but orientation-sensitive: protective forgiveness is sought for believers and is not portrayed as automatic despite terminal truth-covering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final conditional threatens to replace a turning community with another people. This keeps the focus intercession communal but removes possession and complacency: the believers are cared for under God's exclusive claim, not treated as an indispensable collective.

activation_trace.role: Exclusive worship reserves ultimate claim over the community for God.
The named believing collectives anchor the community for whom care is commanded.
Turning away supplies the condition under which communal continuity is challenged.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the mechanism of communal replacement.
A people as a collective supplies the replacement unit and prevents the warning from remaining merely individual.

structural_cues: The surah's final conditional addresses the present group collectively, ties turning away to replacement, and says the replacements will not be like them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collective address, turning, and replacement; I infer that this corrects communal complacency within the focus prayer, while a live alternative limits the warning to failure in expenditure rather than community identity generally.

changed_reading.before: Prayer for believers can sound like care for a fixed and indispensable community.
changed_reading.after: Prayer cares urgently for a contingent community that remains God's, can turn, and can be replaced.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus pair naturally supports ordinary movement, moral course, and final abode before tactical language. It remains anchored in the turning-versus-staying pair and is activated by encounter, war, laying down, strengthened footing, and literal feet; downstream prose should present it only as a martial resonance, never as the primary gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The paired mutaqallab and mathwa can describe changing position and a place of staying.

activation_trace.role: Turning from face to face provides the maneuvering half of the exploratory tactical pair.
Staying in a place provides the encampment or held-position half of the pair.
Two sides coming face to face supplies the concrete encounter in which positions matter.
Setting something down in a fixed place supplies a cessation and position image within the war sequence.
Open warfare defines the cross-domain field that activates tactical motion and rest.
Strengthening something in place contributes steadiness under pressure.
Literal feet turn steadiness into embodied positional control.

changed_reading.before: God knows the addressees' general life movement and dwelling.
changed_reading.after: As a contained martial resonance, God also knows every maneuver, held position, and place of encampment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the focus noun conventionally denotes culpable sin, not a literal tail. It remains anchored in that noun's trailing-end branch, the focus turning root, and repeated contextual backs and reversal; downstream prose should mark it as a material-etymological resonance that supplements rather than replaces the moral sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The request joins the sin noun to protective covering, then closes with God's knowledge of turnings.

activation_trace.role: A tail or trailing end lets wrongdoing be pictured as an aftermath that follows the actor.
Protective covering supplies the requested treatment of that trailing exposure.
Turning from direction to direction connects the trail of fault to a changed course.
Reversal from commitment supplies the moral backturn that gives the trailing image contextual force.
The rear or back of a thing makes the context's backward direction materially explicit.
A second explicit back image carries the reversed trajectory to its terminal exposure.

changed_reading.before: Sin is a bounded item in the past for which pardon is requested.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, sin is also what trails a person through backward turns, so forgiveness covers an aftermath still attached to the course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the whole-company idiom is a remote nominal branch of the forgiveness root and does not define the imperative form. It remains anchored through that root and the explicit paired collectives of believing women and men; downstream prose should render it only as a resonance of exhaustive communal scope.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The request extends from the singular addressee to both gendered believer collectives.

activation_trace.role: An entire company arriving without omission resonates with the request's explicit expansion across the community.
The two believer collectives provide the actual textual scope that contains the remote whole-company resonance.

changed_reading.before: The verse adds two grammatical believer classes to the addressee's prayer.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the paired classes make the intercession sound exhaustive: the believing company is gathered without anyone being left out.

strongest_changes: The covering image acquired opposite moral directions: truth can be destructively covered, while admitted fault can be protectively covered.
The motion-settlement pair expanded from ordinary coordinates into coexisting life-course, moral-reversal, and final-destination readings.
Divine knowing expanded from prior comprehension into knowledge of secrecy, partial recognizability through marks, and manifestation through trial.
Prayer for believers became continuing care for an internally vulnerable and ultimately non-possessed community rather than certification of a fixed secure class.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive latent network was material rather than topical: covers can obstruct or preserve; tails, backs, and reversals can make fault trail a course; marks and tests can make hidden orientation manifest. These activations changed the focus reading while leaving ordinary spatial, doctrinal, and penitential senses intact.
remaining_uncertainties: The relative weight of ordinary movement, moral reversal, life-course, final abode, and tactical positioning in the closing pair remains deliberately unresolved.
The manifestation reading of the later testing-and-knowing clause competes with a discourse-level temporal-acquisition reading.
The trailing-sin and whole-company activations are visibly anchored but branch-distant and should remain qualified in any synthesis.
The later negation of forgiveness may bound the outcome of intercession without directly limiting the act of prayer in the focus verse.
